scope: Actual bundled FamiStudio text lifecycle and visible handlers; immutable preview, guarded append transaction, one Undo/Redo, portable Save As/reopen, source-selection races, original-text receipt and editable generated Audio Runtime ROM. Separate browser/CPU evidence is required; no external-engine or audible equivalence claim.

results.name: Real external export stages an immutable canonical score without editing the project
Import appends editable data with correct references and preserves existing SFX and unrelated owners
One Undo, Redo and actual portable Save As/reopen preserve the imported score
Authenticity, consumed stages and edited or replaced projects cannot install stale imports
Capacity refusal and malformed source leave project and Undo untouched
Visible workflow requires preview and allows cancellation without changing the score
New source selection and song changes invalidate a visible preview
Project edits during confirmation refuse the import without undoing the user edit
A slow file read cannot overwrite a later selected file
Malformed UTF-8, UTF-16, oversized and changed-size files fail before preview
Receipt export preserves original text and the historical import result separately from the project
Imported ordinary note can be edited, saved, reopened and compiled to a real Audio Runtime ROM
